facts.fact: The full final text of the ICT Policy for Lesotho, dated 4 March 2005 with a foreword by the Minister of Communications, Science and Technology, is held and hosted by the Lesotho Communications Authority.
The policy's vision is a knowledge-based society fully integrated in the global economy by 2020, with deployment results anticipated by 2015.
The policy makes the ICT Department of the Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology the lead implementing body, charged with coordination, planning and monitoring and evaluation.
The policy says the ICT Department is to submit an annual government-funded budget and mobilise external resources, but ties no budget line or amount to the policy.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology (ICT Department)

note: The text itself does not state its adoption; adoption in 2005 is stated by other documents. Delivery plan: the text only says a master plan and action plans are to be developed, so no fact.
